_comment: Committed PDK + tool defaults for the layout evidence under layout/.
This is the layout-verification sibling of design/pdk.json and
sim/pdk.json -- deliberately a SEPARATE file, per design/pdk.json's own
comment block precedent ('when a harness lands it brings its own
pdk.json'). open_pdks_commit below MUST match design/pdk.json's and
sim/pdk.json's exactly -- verified 2026-09-05, all three read
variant           sky130 flavor directory used to generate/verify
open_pdks_commit  provenance pin, matches design/pdk.json + sim/pdk.json
klt_deck          the klayout-tools (`klt`) rule-deck name resolved for
this PDK family (--deck sky130 on every klt drc /
klt extract / klt lvs invocation under layout/)
klt_version_pin   the klt release this evidence was generated/verified
provenance pin, not a hard gate, same as
open_pdks_commit above -- re-verifying with a newer
klt is expected to happen and should update this pin
plus the affected evidence directories together.
